assistant.handoffReply: Thank you. I have passed this to the {businessName} team and someone will reply here shortly.
assistant.unknownReply: Good question. I would rather not guess, so I have asked the team to answer you here.
assistant.qualifiedReply: Thank you, that is everything I need. {conversionPrompt}
assistant.afterHandoffReply: Thanks, the team has your message and will reply here.
assistant.bookingRequestReply: Thank you. I have passed your preferred time to the {businessName} team and they will confirm here shortly.
assistant.optOutReply: You will not get any more automatic messages from {businessName}. Reply START if you change your mind.
assistant.optInReply: Welcome back. You will get replies from {businessName} again.
assistant.reviewAsk: Thank you for choosing {businessName}, {firstName}. How did we do? Reply with a number from 1 (poor) to 5 (excellent).
assistant.reviewHappy: Thank you, {firstName}! Would you share that in a quick review? It really helps others find us: {link}
assistant.reviewUnhappy: Thank you for telling us, {firstName}. I am sorry it was not better. I have passed this to the {businessName} team and someone will be in touch.
assistant.missedCallText: Hi, this is {businessName}. Sorry we missed your call. How can we help? Reply here and we will get straight back to you.
assistant.missedCallVoice: Sorry, we could not take your call. We have just sent you a text message.
assistant.formThanks: Thank you. We have your message and will reply shortly.
assistant.formConsent: I agree to receive texts from {businessName} about my enquiry and offers. Reply STOP to opt out at any time.
assistant.formIntro: Leave your details and we will get back to you in minutes.

campaignIdeas.quiet: Hi {firstName}, it's {businessName}. You asked about us a little while ago. Are you still looking? Reply here and we will help straight away.
campaignIdeas.lost: Hi {firstName}, {businessName} here. We have something new that may suit you better than before. Would you like the details?
campaignIdeas.customers: Hi {firstName}, thank you again for choosing {businessName}. As a past customer you get the first look at our latest offer. Reply YES for the details.
campaignIdeas.booked_no_show: Hi {firstName}, we missed you at your appointment with {businessName}. Would you like to choose a new time?
